title: Concept: Test tooling ships into the runtime environment
description: Pipfile declares a test framework declared in Pipfile `[packages]` instead of `[dev-packages]`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a test framework declared in Pipfile `[packages]` instead of `[dev-packages]`.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Pipfile (pypi).
risk: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a test framework declared in Pipfile `[packages]` instead of `[dev-packages]`.
